scores.evidence: All three objectives are can-do statements, and each has 2 or more items with objectiveId, at least one at apply level or above: o1 has q1 (apply) and e1 (analyze); o2 has q2, q3 and e4 (evaluate), plus q0 (predict); o3 has q4 and e5 (apply). o3 is a create objective but is tested by apply-level multiple choice; the create step itself happens in practice-spec.

hook-problem is a concrete scenario in 2 sentences (「ほしかったのは、スマートフォンでボタンがはみ出すのを直すことだけでした」) with no trivia, and s1-example and s3-steps later solve exactly this problem. q0 is ungraded, and each of its distractors encodes a brief misconception (stronger adjectives, Manual mode, /rewind).

The rewrite of s1-table into a list removes the jargon that needed glosses (モック and ウィジェット are gone). Every item now just names what to write under each heading, such as 「**参照先**には、@参照するファイル、URL、Gitの履歴など、読ませたい情報源を書きます。」, which uses @参照 just after s1-defs defines it. The earlier small gap stays: package.json in q3 is never explained.

measure.mjs prints 「prose 2399 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 3065 · practice reading 1452 · questions 8 · practice sections 2 · est 19.4 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」. So estMinutes now matches the rounded estimate, but body prose sits 1 char under the cap: turning the two tables into sentence lists added prose. Lint shows 0 warnings. s2 still holds 8 blocks.

s3-steps now has 6 steps, within the contract's 3–6. Each step has a subgoal title and a reason: ex-explore 「ファイルを変えずに調べられます」, ex-plan 「書く前に、進め方を読める形にするためです」, ex-commit 「記録すれば、あとで戻せます」. ex-fix models reading the plan against the stated scope. It goes from the full example straight to practice, with no faded step in between.

Every content section has an inline check, and q1, q2 and q3 ask for application in new contexts. q2 option a (「初めて触るリポジトリで、READMEの誤字」) makes the learner weigh two cues against each other. e5 is fixed: b (「この会話のまま続けて実装して」) and d now encode real misconceptions. However, q4 and e5 both use the s4 example (家計簿アプリの予算), and both keys hinge on the same element (writing to SPEC.md). e5 c (「早めに切り上げて」) also partly clashes with the stem's 「詳しく…掘り下げて」.

Every misconception in the brief appears as a distractor with reasoned feedback of at most 2 sentences: stronger adjectives (q0 a), Manual mode (q0 b, e4 d), /rewind (q0 d, e4 b 「Bashで変えたものや外部への操作を戻せません」), the classifier (e4 c), trusting the plan (q3 c), always planning (q2 b), files already changed (q3 d), and the same conversation or Claude remembering (q4 c, e5 b, e5 d).

s2-flow is still a 5-node process diagram with the 「直したい点がある」 loop, a takeaway caption and descriptive alt text. Turning s1-table and s4-table into short bullet lists fits their content, since each item is one rule and needs no second column. practice-starter's highlight [14–18] now matches the addItem function after the lines were rewrapped (line 14 is 「function addItem(text) {」 and line 18 is its closing brace). There are no decorative images.

The setup is now unambiguous. practice-setup has 「# ここでtodo.htmlを保存」 between git init and git add, and pr-setup says 「最初の3行でフォルダーを作り、その中に `todo.html` を保存します。最後の2行でコミットしてから…」. The checklist, the model marked 「書いてから見比べましょう」, and expect, hint and troubleshoot on ② and ④ are unchanged. As before, the hint ladder has 2 levels, not 3, and ps-ask's expect leaves out 「当たり前の質問はしない」, which c2-depth requires.

summary-points still has 5 points after the exam. Point 3 is shorter: 「差分を1文で説明できる変更は直接頼み、迷う変更やよく知らないコードは計画します。」 It drops 複数のファイル, which s2-when and s4-table keep (see niceToHave). summary-next keeps its reflection prompt and next step, there are 7 flashcards, and askTutor has 3 suggestions.

The changed claims match facts-cc-03, which says the guide gives 「scope the task, point to sources, reference existing patterns, describe the symptom」 and 「use @ to reference files, paste images, give URLs」. s1-table follows this, s4-good-spec's 「最後は全体を確かめる手順で終わります」 matches 「end with an end-to-end verification step」, and card-good-spec uses the same 全体. s2-enter's third item still names the same command, 「`claude --permission-mode plan` で起動する」. The blocks keep their cite entries.

The changed text stays です・ます and warm (s4-community 「まずは3-4の依頼文で、手で仕様を作ってみましょう」; s4-table 「…は、**直接頼みます**。」). Lint finds no banned phrases, and the terms 参照先, 仕様 and プランモード stay consistent with the glossary. Detailed wording is left to the ja-editor.
The lesson is jp only and complete. The diagram labels are Japanese, s2-flow has descriptive alt text, the only link uses descriptive text (「autoモードが使えない環境」), and no text is baked into images.

niceToHave: s1-table: turning it into a list removed the official per-perspective rewrite examples (for example 「`foo.py` のテストで、ログアウト中の場合を扱う」), so o1 now has one worked rewrite (s1-example) before q1. If prose allows, add a short example to the 症状 item, which q1 tests: 「**症状**には、起きていること、場所の見当、直った状態を書きます（例：タイムアウト後にログインできない。`src/auth/` を調べて直す）。」. Prose is at 2399 of 2,400, so trim the same amount elsewhere.

s1-lead: the change dropped the reason the 4 perspectives matter (「依頼があいまいだと、どのファイルをどこまで変えるかも推測で決まります。」). The lead now only says Claude cannot read minds. Consider restoring the dropped sentence, or append 「だから、範囲や症状を言葉で渡します。」.
summary-points point 3: the shortened text drops 複数のファイル, and 「迷う変更」 is vaguer than s2-when's 「進め方に迷うとき」. Consider 「差分を1文で説明できる変更は直接頼み、進め方に迷う変更や、複数のファイル・よく知らないコードを変えるときは計画します。」.
pr-setup: 「最初の3行でフォルダーを作り」 also covers git init, which does not create a folder. Consider 「最初の3行でフォルダーを作ってGitを始め、その中に `todo.html` を保存します。」.
check-quiz e5 (carried over): the item reuses the s4 scenario (家計簿アプリの予算), so it is not a new context for o3. Change the stem's feature to 「読書記録アプリに、本の貸し出しの機能を足したい。」.
check-quiz e5 option c (carried over): 「早めに切り上げて」 can be ruled out from the stem alone. Consider md 「質問は、技術的な実装についてだけにして。」 with feedback 「話題を絞ると、画面やエッジケースの判断が仕様に残りません。UI/UXやトレードオフも聞いてもらいます。」.
practice-spec-steps ps-ask (carried over): change expect to 「AskUserQuestionと、聞いてほしい話題が3つ以上、「当たり前の質問はしない」が入ります。」 so that it matches c2-depth.
factual doubt (carried over): s3-tip 「説明を求めた人は、任せきりの人より理解度テストの点が高くなりました」 reads as causal. Consider 「…点が高い傾向がありました。」.
s3-check q3 (carried over): gloss package.json at its first use: 「package.json（使うライブラリを書くファイル）」.
s2-version (carried over): the link uses the /docs/ja/ URL, but the cited source cc-permission-modes is the /en/ page. Consider using the /en/ URL.
summary: This is a verification round: review-scope exited 0, with 12 of 44 blocks changed (17%) and sections and objectives unchanged. The round-1 review had no must-fix items, so no resolved entries are needed. I reviewed every changed block in full and found no new error and no regression. The tables became lists, practice-starter's highlight still matches addItem, the setup order is clearer, and estMinutes 19 matches the estimate of 19.4. Body prose is now 2399 of 2,400, so any further additions need trimming elsewhere. The carried-over suggestions (a new scenario for e5, the ps-ask expect) are still the most useful improvements.
